tools.name: viuz_get_playbook
tools.description: Returns Viuz's playbook: how to run the member's content work with these tools. Pure guidance.

tools.name: viuz_list_brands
tools.description: Lists the brands available on this connection. Pass its brand_id on each call when more than one brand is connected.

tools.name: viuz_get_context
tools.description: Brand name, handles, language, plan tier, connected accounts, usage left. Reads only. brand_id required when the connection has more than one brand.

tools.name: viuz_get_plan
tools.description: Read strategy, cycles and the editable week of the Weekly Plan. Never generates, schedules or publishes.

tools.name: viuz_get_next_to_make
tools.description: Read the next unexecuted plan item. No generation, scheduling or spend.

tools.name: viuz_get_brief
tools.description: Strategy brief for a post. No generation; one model call.

tools.name: viuz_list_posts
tools.description: Lists the brand's posts, newest first, with status and platforms.

tools.name: viuz_generate_post
tools.description: Renders a post in the brand's templates. Spends one of the plan's monthly generations. Send confirm_spend true only after the member agreed to the cost in this conversation.

tools.name: viuz_generate_image
tools.description: Generates an AI image into the library. Spends one monthly AI image.

tools.name: viuz_prepare_schedule
tools.description: Creates a schedule proposal the member reviews and approves in Viuz.

tools.name: viuz_schedule_post
tools.description: Schedules a post at a time on connected accounts.

tools.name: viuz_publish_now
tools.description: Publishes a post right away on connected accounts. No window to cancel.
